stands — after a fair callout that prior "verification" spot-checked a few suites and over-claimed
"all green."

## Truth map — all 119 test suites run, none skipped silently
| bucket | count | meaning |
|---|---|---|

| **cannotRun** | 72 | need `vitest`/ESM — **NOT verifiable in this offline environment** (no network to install vitest) |

**Only ~39% of the suite is verifiable in this environment.** The other 61% require a vitest CI

## The 1 real failure
- `v243.test.js` — asserts `CHANGELOG_V243.md` exists. It's a stale suite from an interim agent
  (version 243); that changelog was never carried forward. Not a logic bug, not my code. Reported,
  not deleted — I will not remove another agent's test to improve the count.

## A real regression I introduced and have now CORRECTED
V497 archived 62 "orphan" modules as dead. My scan checked `require()` references but **not test-file
references** — so it wrongly archived 11 modules that test suites depend on, breaking at least
`v482.test.js`. My V497 report claimed "zero regressions"; that was wrong. V502 restored all 11
(`providerAdapters267`, `alertDigest279`, `alertEscalation277`, `alertSla278`, `digestScheduler281`,
`notificationChannel280/283`, `notificationChannelFilter284`, `notificationTemplate282`,
`presetGroups286`, `filterPresets285`) and made the V497 manifest truthful (51 actually archived).

- SACRED intact: `fiatLedger.js` 563e9b1f…, `auditLog.js` e5a5c2c2…
- Server `node --check` passes.
